text:
The plate looks like a side plate of about 20-22 cm. It holds two strips of well-done bacon or similar cured meat, plus chopped egg whites with some hot sauce.

Bacon: the strips are about 15 cm long. Two strips of thick bacon weigh roughly 25 g together when cooked, or perhaps 30-40 g if they are thick, fatty, or glazed. At about 4.5 kcal/g, 35 g comes to roughly 150 kcal.

Egg: this looks like scrambled or chopped egg white, about 50 g. At about 1.5 kcal/g, that is roughly 75 kcal, plus a little sauce.

Total: about 85 g and about 230 kcal.
